StageAttempt.title: StageAttempt
StageAttempt.description: Records an insurance agent's role-play stage attempt, multi-dimensional evaluation scores, and AI voice tone coaching feedback.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who completed the stage.

agentName.description: Display name of the insurance agent.

teamCode.description: Team identifier code for group training.

category.description: Category of the insurance training stage.

rapportScore.description: Rapport and trust building score from 0 to 100.

factFindingScore.description: Fact-finding and questioning depth score from 0 to 100.

preApproachScore.description: Needs analysis and insurance concept bridging score from 0 to 100.

voiceToneScore.description: Voice tone, pacing, warmth, and confidence score from 0 to 100.

voiceFeedback.description: Detailed AI feedback on the agent's vocal tone and pacing.

coachSummary.description: Actionable coaching feedback and strengths/improvements from Gemini.

passed.description: Whether the agent achieved the passing threshold (>= 70).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AgentTelemetry.title: AgentTelemetry
AgentTelemetry.description: Aggregated user activity, login/visit count, stages entered, stages passed, and average scores for the Admin Website and Dashboard.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated agent.

teamCode.description: Team code the agent belongs to.

visitCount.description: Total number of app visits and training sessions started.

totalAttemptsCount.description: Total number of role-play stage evaluations completed.

enteredStagesCsv.description: Comma-separated list of stage numbers (1-25) the agent has entered/played.

completedStagesCsv.description: Comma-separated list of stage numbers (1-25) the agent has passed (>=70).

enteredStagesCount.description: Count of unique stages entered by the agent.

completedStagesCount.description: Count of unique stages passed by the agent.

bestOverallScore.description: Highest overall score achieved by the agent (0-100).

averageOverallScore.description: Average overall score across all attempts (0-100).

averageVoiceScore.description: Average voice tone score across all attempts (0-100).

lastActiveStage.description: Most recent stage number entered or completed (0-25).

lastActiveStageTitle.description: Title of the most recent stage entered or completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when telemetry profile was first created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when telemetry was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

StaffPermission.title: StaffPermission
StaffPermission.description: Stores Gmail-based access permissions and approval status for Secretaries and Sub-Admins assisting the team.

userId.description: The UID of the user who created or requested the permission record.

staffEmail.description: Gmail address of the secretary or assistant admin.

staffName.description: Display name or title of the secretary/staff member.

status.description: Approval status of the staff member.

canViewVisitsAndStages.description: Whether the secretary can view agent visit counts and stages entered.

canViewScores.description: Whether the secretary can view 5-dimension evaluation scores and voice tone feedback.

canExportCsv.description: Whether the secretary can export and download CSV reports.

canManageTeam.description: Whether the secretary can manage team settings and approve other staff.

approvedByEmail.description: Gmail of the admin who approved or updated this permission.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/stage_attempts/{attemptId}.description: Stores role-play stage attempts and 5-dimension evaluation scores scoped to the authenticated user and readable by Admin.

/agent_telemetry/{userId}.description: Stores per-agent visit counts, stages entered, stages passed, and score averages for the Admin Website.

/staff_permissions/{permissionId}.description: Stores Secretary and Sub-Admin Gmail approvals and granular access flags.
